row:
Ehrlich Animal Hospital is a five doctor, full service veterinary hospital, specializing in the treatment of cats and dogs, as well as exotic animals.

Our goal is to provide the best veterinary care with a cheerful, caring, and compassionate attitude to help our patients live a long and healthy life. Our doctors make daily phone calls to clients to make sure thier pet is still doing well after its visit to the hospital. Our purpose is to treat all pets as our own and treat clients the way we would want to be treated.
